<!-- Without output-id the div uses the last block; with a template the exit still works and needs no `os` import. A marker for another name stays inert. -->

```{.go .run template="mainfunc"}
fmt.Println("one")
// exit: a
fmt.Println("two")
// exit: b
fmt.Println("three")
```
